prompts.text: Roast the person who says 'let me play devil's advocate' in every meeting.
Roast the endless 'quick sync' that turns into an hour.
Roast the meeting that could have been a Slack message.
Roast the onboarding doc written in 2019 that no one updated.
Roast the group chat that pings 47 times about lunch.
Roast the calendar invite sent at 5 PM for an 8 AM meeting.
Roast the shared drive with 14 versions of 'final_final_v2'.
Roast the projector that only works when you're 10 minutes late.
Roast the 'quick question' that arrives right as you sit down to focus.
Roast the intern's first pull request titled 'stuff'.
